# What Immutable records

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_policy_doc.py from src/immutable/policy.py. Do not edit. -->

Immutable records fingerprints and coarse milestones. The list below is the whole list:
an event type that is not here cannot exist, and a field that is not listed for its type
cannot be carried. There is no free-text field.

## Never recorded

- keystrokes or typing rhythm
- screen contents or screenshots
- camera images or video
- microphone audio
- biometrics of any kind
- the clipboard
- window titles or the list of open programs
- browsing history or network traffic
- file contents between saves (only hashes)
- the text a program printed (only its hash)

No event type or field above can carry any of these, which is why the guarantee holds.

## Every event also carries bookkeeping

Which exam, session and seat it belongs to, its position in the chain, the boot it
happened in, this computer's clock readings, and the hash of the event before it.

## Event types

### SESSION_START

A session opened. Records the hash of the exam paper, the hash of the roster and the agent version.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `paper_sha256` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `roster_sha256` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `agent_ver` | a short printable ASCII label (up to 32 characters) |

### BOOT

The agent started, or resumed after a restart.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `reason` | one of: `start`, `resume` |

### FILE_SAVE

A file in the workspace changed. Records its path, its SHA-256 and its size. Never its contents.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `path` | a relative file path inside the workspace |
| `sha256` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `size` | a non-negative whole number |

### RUN_START

The student ran a file. Records the path and hash of the file that ran.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `path` | a relative file path inside the workspace |
| `sha256` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |

### RUN_END

The run finished. Records the exit code, the duration and the hash of the output. Never the output.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `exit_code` | a whole number |
| `stdout_sha256` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `duration_ms` | a non-negative whole number |

### SUBMIT

Final submission. Records the hash of the file manifest and the number of files.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `manifest_sha256` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `file_count` | a non-negative whole number |

### CHECKPOINT

A Merkle root over earlier events, so a long log can be checked quickly.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `merkle_root` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `upto_seq` | a non-negative whole number |

### HEARTBEAT

A sign of life. Carries no data.

No fields.

### RECOVERY

The agent restarted after a power cut or crash. Records the last good event and how many bytes were discarded.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `last_good_seq` | a non-negative whole number |
| `discarded_bytes` | a non-negative whole number |

### TRANSFER

An assessor-signed move of the student to a different seat. Records the old seat, its last event and head, and the assessor's signature.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `from_ws_id` | a short identifier (letters, digits, . _ -) |
| `from_last_seq` | a non-negative whole number |
| `from_head` | a SHA-256 hash (64 hex characters) |
| `assessor_sig` | an Ed25519 signature (128 hex characters) |

### SESSION_END

The session closed: submitted, timed out or aborted.

| Field | Allowed value |
|---|---|
| `reason` | one of: `submitted`, `timeout`, `aborted` |

## Things to know

- File **names** are recorded (paths relative to the workspace). Name files accordingly.
- Contents of submitted files are kept at submission, so they can be marked and disputes settled.
- Candidates appear under a pseudonymous ID from the roster, never a real name.
